execution.entry_reason: The declared call_chain[0] TorchDevice.mha is the prefill compute helper that SelfAttention.forward itself calls through self.compute.mha; the call dependency is the reverse of the chain, so it can never reach the target (step-4 analysis: call_chain_status=not_found). The driver therefore calls the Region's own function SelfAttention.forward (call_chain index 1) with the real ValueHolder/TorchTensor arguments a decoding step receives, and the target line runs inside that real function body.
